FN-34UPGBRR-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 153
Committee: Judiciary Sponsor: Senator Linda Coleman-Madison
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 04/01/2025
Senate Bill 153 as introduced would increase the administrative obligations of the Board of
Pardons and Paroles by an undetermined amount to post the name and information of each
individual whose right to vote has been restored on the Board's website.
Further, this bill would also increase the administrative obligations of the Secretary of State
(SOS) by an undetermined amount to: (1) make available on the SOS's website the form and
instructions developed jointly with the Board of Pardons and Paroles to aid individuals seeking
to have their voting rights restored; and (2) notify each individual and the county registrars that
voting rights have been restored.
